run_prepare_qa_cli: run the prepare_qa script to download and preprocess TriviaQA and NaturalQuestions datasets into JSONL format
run_preprocess_triviaqa: run preprocess_triviaqa to convert raw TriviaQA data into JSONL files with question, answers, and target fields
run_preprocess_nq: run preprocess_nq to convert raw NaturalQuestions data into JSONL files with question and answers fields
run_convert_triviaqa: run convert_triviaqa to transform a single TriviaQA example into a normalized dict with title-cased target
run_convert_nq: run convert_nq to transform a single NaturalQuestions example into a normalized dict with question and answers
